ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible macro-ratio of approximately 1:3 high-intensity to low-intensity pixels across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity zone on the left lobe distal half containing internal low-intensity focal spots; mottled high-intensity zone on the right lobe distal tip; dominant low-intensity zone throughout the central and proximal regions of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree vertex angle and depth relative to lobe height of 1:4.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile along the entirety of the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude valleys and peaks compared to the smoother left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Group of three distinct circular low-intensity clusters within the high-intensity left lobe field; additional smaller clusters localized near the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the left central lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct parallel rake marks on left lobe surface; multiple irregular indentations and notches on the right lobe trailing edge.
